## Approach & Optimization

Phase 5 of the Ollama-agent experimentation revealed a critical bottleneck: memory exhaustion when employing the bulk approach with complex, multi-turn interactions.  The iterative Ollama-agent strategy, where a single, focused prompt is generated per call utilizing a fast model like Gemma3, proved significantly more robust.  This “1 test per call” methodology drastically reduced the memory footprint by avoiding the accumulation of intermediate states and lengthy context windows.  Crucially, this approach yielded a 100% success rate in achieving the desired outcome, a dramatic improvement over the initial 50% success rate observed when attempting to process information in a larger, bulk fashion, demonstrating the importance of minimizing context and prioritizing rapid, targeted queries.
